title: Warnings, Conditions & Threats — Consolidation
goal: Integrate warnings with como + subjunctive, si-clauses, conditional conjunctions, non-si conditions and past regrets
grammar: Unit 19 review: como-condicional-subjuntivo, si-clauses, hypothetical-structures, conditional-conjunctions, implicit-conditionals, regrets-reproaches, pluscuamperfecto-subjuntivo-si

items: I can issue warnings with *como* + subjunctive and contrast them with causal *como* + indicative.
I can use real, hypothetical and mixed *si*-clauses alongside *a menos que*, *con tal de que* and *siempre que*.
I can build compact conditions with *de* + infinitive and conditional gerunds.
I can express past regrets, reproaches and counterfactual near misses fluently.
